name: NVIDIA RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell SFF Edition (measured on CONTAK-01)
description: Low-profile single-slot Blackwell (sm_120, compute capability 12.0) workstation GPU with a 70 W board power limit, distinct from the higher-TDP full-size RTX PRO 4000. This item is grounded in a local nvidia-smi reading of the exact card used for the #10 inference measurements (2x in one box), not a vendor reference sheet. Research snapshot; no serving or training-fit claim.

provenance.notes: Local nvidia-smi reading of the exact card (2x in one box) on CONTAK-01: name 'NVIDIA RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell SFF Edition', compute capability 12.0 (sm_120, Blackwell), FB memory total 24467 MiB (24 GiB advertised, 25.656 decimal GB), board power limit 70 W (min 60 / max 70), PCIe interconnect, single slot, no NVLink. Driver 580.126.09. This is a measured device identity, not a vendor reference sheet; the 70 W limit distinguishes the SFF variant from the full-size RTX PRO 4000. The precision set follows precision-reference.json CC 12.0 (fp32, tf32, bf16, fp16, fp8, int8); int4 is omitted because CUDA Table 33 marks the INT4 cell blank for CC 12.x, and Blackwell's native FP4/FP6 are absent from the v1 enum. A precision listing does not assert that an arbitrary quantized checkpoint runs.

CUDA GPU table lists the RTX PRO 4000 Blackwell family at compute capability 12.0, supporting the CUDA backend identity. This does not pin a driver or CUDA runtime version, and does not establish engine/artifact/kernel compatibility.
